controls.customerSafeStatement: DealerFlow applies organization-scoped authorization and forced PostgreSQL row-level security to tested tenant data paths.

controls.objective: Enforce least-privilege capabilities and location scope
controls.customerSafeStatement: Application actions require current tenant membership, explicit capabilities, enabled modules, and applicable location scope.
The implemented Twilio callback validates provider signatures and resolves a tenant-specific integration route.

controls.objective: Keep deployment and provider credentials server-side and bounded
controls.customerSafeStatement: DealerFlow validates required server-side configuration and does not expose configured secret values through its readiness contract.

controls.objective: Avoid secrets and direct customer identifiers in operational telemetry
controls.customerSafeStatement: Structured operational telemetry filters defined sensitive attribute names and avoids logging full customer content.

controls.objective: Restrict initial account creation to approved invitations
controls.customerSafeStatement: Dealership account creation is invitation-bound and validates the invited organization and normalized email.

controls.objective: Keep AI recommendations tenant-scoped, evidence-based, and human-reviewed
controls.customerSafeStatement: Implemented AI recommendations are tenant-gated, use bounded evidence, and preserve explicit human review for governed decisions.

controls.objective: Provide keyboard, focus, semantic, responsive, and contrast-conscious UI behavior
controls.customerSafeStatement: Selected core workflows have scoped keyboard, semantic, responsive, zoom, focus, and contrast testing; DealerFlow does not claim formal WCAG conformance.
Production backup configuration and freshness evidence have not yet been verified.

controls.objective: Prove isolated restoration of representative tenant data
controls.customerSafeStatement: A current isolated restore drill has not yet been completed; configured backup capability is not represented as tested recovery.

controls.objective: Prove external alert delivery and escalation ownership
controls.customerSafeStatement: Application alert delivery support exists, but an external receiver and escalation drill are not yet verified.

controls.objective: Review and revoke internal privileged access
controls.customerSafeStatement: A canonical recurring privileged-access review process has not yet been implemented.
DealerFlow has not completed an independent penetration test or security certification.
